scope: Create evidence-grounded neutral key points and controlled topic assignments.
release_reason: Single permitted local Qwen attempt failed the strict quality gate: only 6/8 natural segments were enriched, with two parse errors and two skipped/invalid segments. Sampling also found semantic overreach, including converting a quoted plan to make a surprise trip to Saudi Arabia into a claim that the trip itself was to conduct a surprise attack. Generated key-point/topic files discarded; deterministic natural segments restored. Transcript, cue, and segment stages remain completed; key-point stage deferred to tail.
